result.journal: EURASIP Journal on Wireless Communications and Networking
result.keywords: AbstractThis paper studies a traffic-aware channel estimation framework for urban wireless communication networks using massive MIMO base stations and low-resolution ADCs. By jointly exploiting temporal traffic variation and spatial channel correlation, the proposed method combines a predictive traffic model with Kalman-based adaptive estimation. The received quantized signals are linearized through a Bussgang-style approximation, and a truncated polynomial expansion is used to reduce computational complexity. Simulation results indicate improved estimation accuracy and robustness under rapidly changing urban demand patterns.
